`Yes, CVD (Chemical Vapor Deposition) diamonds are real, authentic diamonds`.[[1]](https://www.queensmith.co.uk/diamond-guides/lab-grown-diamonds/cvd-diamonds-what-are-they)[[2]](https://www.ourosjewels.com/blogs/fine-jewelry/are-cvd-diamonds-real-diamonds-everything-you-need-to-know)

They are not fake stones, cubic zirconia, or moissanite. Major gemological authorities—including the [Gemological Institute of America (GIA)](https://www.gia.edu/) and the [International Gemological Institute (IGI)](https://www.igi.org/) —classify them as real diamonds.[[1]](https://www.ourosjewels.com/blogs/fine-jewelry/are-cvd-diamonds-real-diamonds-everything-you-need-to-know)[[2]](https://www.mangrovediamonds.com/blogs/news/cvd-vs-hpht-lab-grown-diamonds-what-s-the-difference)

### Why They Are Real Diamonds

- **Chemical Composition:** They consist of pure carbon atoms arranged in the exact same crystal lattice structure as mined diamonds.
- **Physical Properties:** They score a 10 on the Mohs hardness scale and have the same brilliance, fire, and refractive index (2.42) as natural stones.
- **Optical Behavior:** Even professional jewelers cannot tell them apart from earth-mined diamonds by eye.[[1]](https://www.mangrovediamonds.com/blogs/news/cvd-vs-hpht-lab-grown-diamonds-what-s-the-difference)[[2]](https://www.ourosjewels.com/blogs/fine-jewelry/are-cvd-diamonds-real-diamonds-everything-you-need-to-know)

### How They Differ From Mined Diamonds

- **Origin:** They are grown in a controlled laboratory using carbon gases and a diamond seed, rather than forming underground over millions of years.
- **Detection:** Specialized equipment is required to identify microscopic growth patterns that reveal their laboratory origin.
- **Cost and Ethics:** They generally cost less than mined diamonds and have a verifiable, conflict-free supply chain.[[1]](https://www.ritani.com/blogs/education/cvd-vs-hpht-lab-grown-diamonds-what-s-the-difference)[[2]](https://www.brilliantearth.com/guides/how-are-lab-grown-diamonds-made/)[[3]](https://www.queensmith.co.uk/diamond-guides/lab-grown-diamonds/cvd-diamonds-what-are-they)[[4]](https://www.mangrovediamonds.com/blogs/news/cvd-vs-hpht-lab-grown-diamonds-what-s-the-difference)[[5]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:11382354394104671776&ibp=oshop)[[6]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:10706020693303404710&ibp=oshop)
